question: Hymns of Rig Veda are also known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Suktas**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Rigveda

 
 
• It is an ancient Indian collection of Vedic Sanskrit hymns.
 
• It is the oldest known Vedic Sanskrit text.
 
• It is one of the four sacred canonical texts of Hinduism.
 
• It contains 1028 hymns which are arranged in 10 mandalas.
 
• The sum of the hymns in Rigveda is in the form of Dialogue.
 
• Hymns of the Rigveda are known as Sukta.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Janas**: Refers to early Vedic tribes or communities in ancient India, led by kings or chieftains (rajas), which formed the basis of Vedic social organization.
 
• **Rudras**: A group of deities in Vedic tradition, often associated with storms, wind, and destruction. Rudra, a fierce aspect of Shiva, is the leader of these deities.
 
• **Rituals**: In Vedic culture, rituals were central to religious practices, involving sacrifices (yajnas) performed to honor gods, maintain cosmic order, and seek blessings for prosperity and success.
